items.difficulty_reason: Verification of the triangulated category axiom (C) for the homotopy category of dg modules: from the admissible short exact sequence 0 -> L -> C(f) -> K[1] -> 0 the author must show the boundary map delta : K[1] -> L[1] represents f, and does so by evaluating the connecting morphism on the explicit section (0, 1), obtaining f as required. Retained author proof at lines 2700-2740.
